text_sections.label: Special Digivolution Condition
text_sections.text: [App Fusion] [Watchmon] & [Savemon] & [Calendamon]: Cost 0 (If 2 such cards are linked together, stack the link card on top and digivolve.)

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: ＜Blocker＞ [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon gets linked, ＜De-Digivolve 1＞ 1 of your opponent's Digimon.

text_sections.label: Inherited Effect
text_sections.text: ＜Link＞ [Appmon] trait: Cost 2 (Plug this card from the hand or battle area sideways into the specified Digimon in the battle area.) [When Linking] ＜De-Digivolve 1＞ 1 of your opponent's Digimon.
